note: Draft manifest found by payload fingerprinting on one EU replay (no client defs). V = verified against that replay's battle results, O = observed, ? = guess. Kills (vehicleKilled) were NOT found: this replay has no updateArena kill message, so kills must come from health events until located.

showTracer.args: u32 shooterVehicleId, u32 shotId, ... (50 B); recorder count equals results shots (25)

stopTracer.args: u32 shotId, f32[3] endPoint (16 B); every end matches a shot id (121/121)

updateArena.args: u8 updateType, bwstring pickle; type 3 period 3 = battle start

onHealthChanged.args: i16 newHealth, i16 oldHealth, u32 attackerId, u8 reason, u8 flag (10 B); recorder damage sums to results damageDealt (6753)
